articles.summary: Daily flights bring JetBlue to Indianapolis for the first time and mark its return to Columbus, adding to a Fort Lauderdale network that will serve 61 nonstop destinations this winter To celebrate the launch, limited one-way fares are available starting at $59 in Main and $138 in EvenMore only at jetblue.com JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) will launch today daily nonstop flights between Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) and both Indianapolis International Airport (IND) and John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH), bringing new travel options to customers in the Midwest as the airline continues to expand its Fort Lauderdale network. The inaugural flights bring JetBlue to Indianapolis for the first time and mark the airline’s return to Columbus. articles.title: JetBlue Launches New Nonstop Service from Fort Lauderdale to Indianapolis and Columbus Today
